name: AFM level 2 task 9: Friction Repeatability And Surface-Check Measurement
description: Acquire exactly three consecutive contact-mode lateral-force images of the same region without changing any acquisition parameter. Use a scan size of 5 µm × 5 µm, resolution of 256 × 256 pixels, time per line of 0.075 s, normal-force setpoint of 10 nN, and P/I/D gains of 100/50/0. For every acquisition, calculate average friction magnitude and its spatial standard deviation from the lateral channels, and calculate rms and average roughness from the height channel.
